Name: Ulam, Son of Eshek
Summary: Firstborn son of Eshek, a mighty man of valour whose sons were archers.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:39: Firstborn son of Eshek, a mighty man of valour whose sons were archers.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ulam stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
